description: Validation status for standalone devices and exact controller plus captive-modem combinations used by Speedtest Analyzer.

status_values.pending: Show the Not yet validated informational alert.

instructions: Matching is case-insensitive and model-family based. For example, E3000 matches E3000-5GB and W1850 matches W1850-5GB or W1850-5GC.
To approve a tested entry, change status from pending to validated and set validated_date to YYYY-MM-DD.
Do not change a pending entry to validated until the exact standalone device or controller plus captive-modem combination has been tested.
Each physical captive adapter is counted once even when NCOS reports separate SIM1 and SIM2 WAN records.
Single-captive combinations are grouped first by controller and then by captive model for easy maintenance.
Multiple-captive combinations are order-independent but count-sensitive. One W1850 differs from two W1850 adapters.
An attached captive modem that is not listed, or an extra captive modem beyond a validated entry, remains not validated.
Examples are documentation only and are never loaded as validation entries.
Known defects are independent of validation status. A confirmed defect disables only the matching engine and hardware selection.

confirmed_firmware records the simple NCOS version where the defect was reproduced. fixed_in null keeps the restriction active on all firmware; when fixed_in is set, that version and newer are enabled.
Restart or rebuild the application after changing this file so the catalog is reloaded.

known_defects.reason: Native NCOS Netperf can hang or run indefinitely on this standalone device.
Native NCOS Netperf can continue beyond the requested duration and fail to produce results when the selected WAN is the RC1250 captive modem.
The bundled iPerf3 executable is incompatible with the AER2200 platform and cannot be launched.
